census.input_convention: All labelled nonplane rooted binary trees on range(n), times all canonical restricted-growth color vectors on those labels
census.partitions_scored: EVERY source-valid monochromatic partition, not only colored optima
census.budget_checks: For every integer q from 0 through n-1, output exactly the unpruned emitted cores of actual cost at most q; compare all source-valid partitions achievable within q to emitted coarsenings
failure_conditions: any invalid source cut or mismatch on original-label reconstruction
paid cost differs from nonredundant original cut count or pieces-1
exact mass exceeds c^(1-r) for a tested c
census.extension_stop_rule: Measure pilot and write projected denominator/time before n5. Stop/restructure if a projection exceeds two hours. No larger n authorized in this run.

independence.prototype: New direct recursive group-deletion code, no reference imports, no optimum calls
independence.reference: Existing earlier X0 fresh_oracle.py explicit original vertices, paths, source partitions and cut graph; unchanged
independence.shared: Literal pinned plants and standard source-partition definitions; this is finite adversarial testing of a prototype, not independent production verification
forbidden: require emitted core to be target agreement
promote finite checks to universal or Lean closure
